caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with a rustic appearance, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chair is constructed from roughly hewn wood with visible grain and knots, colored in shades of brown and grey. There are three horizontal slats on the backrest, which are slightly curved and irregular in shape. The chair has four cylindrical legs, connected by round wooden stretchers on the sides, front, and back. The seat is made from woven material, appearing frayed and torn in several places, revealing gaps and loose strands, and is depicted in a worn light brown color. There is an artist's signature, "Annie G. Johnston," in the bottom right corner. The overall composition places the chair in the center with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Handmade Chair
